entities.title: Cypherpunk Technologies Inc. (Nasdaq: CYPH)
entities.role: Public-company ZEC treasury vehicle, formerly Leap Therapeutics; rebranded 12 Nov 2025; the largest disclosed corporate ZEC holder and, since Aug 2026, a Zcash miner.
entities.exposure: 323,394.38 ZEC, $110.5M total cost, $341.83 avg cost (30 Jun 2026 10-Q); ~1.92% of supply; stated target 5% of network
entities.summary: Nasdaq-listed digital asset treasury company seeded by Winklevoss Capital to accumulate ZEC; the hub of the disclosed Winklevoss/Cypherpunk/ZODL/Shielded Labs/Gemini lattice.
entities.body: Rebranded from Leap Therapeutics 12 Nov 2025 on a $58.888M private placement led by Winklevoss Capital as sole institutional investor. Purchase ledger: 12 Nov 2025 203,775.27 ZEC @ $245.37; 18-19 Nov 29,869 @ ~$603; 30 Dec 56,418.09 @ $514.02; 12 Mar 2026 ~4,680 @ ~$428; 15 Apr 9,163.32 @ $234.63; Apr-Jun ~19,488 undisclosed, reaching 323,394.38 ZEC. Stopped press-releasing individual purchases 15 Apr 2026. Shares outstanding grew +223% YoY (83.9M to 107.76M) against 80.77M pre-funded warrants and a $200M Cantor ATM. CEO Douglas E. Onsi and CIO Will McEvoy (a Winklevoss Capital principal) each received 1,000,000 RSUs (2 Jul 2026). On 18 Aug 2026 it bought a Zcash mining fleet (4.2 GSol/s, ~18% of network hashrate) for $33.33M in equity from Winklevoss Capital affiliates -- the same entity that seeded the company. Correction to the standard DAT critique: CYPH trades at a discount on basic shares (~0.6x mNAV at $790 ZEC), not a premium -- the story is dilution into a discount.

entities.title: Zooko Wilcox-O'Hearn
entities.role: Zcash co-founder; ECC CEO 2015 to 18 Dec 2023; Bootstrap executive director until 5 Jul 2024; Chief Product Officer at Shielded Labs (Dec 2025-); paid strategic advisor to Cypherpunk Technologies (Dec 2025-); Founders' Reward recipient.
entities.exposure: Founders' Reward 0.9% of total supply, paid at 2,033 ZEC/month (2016-2020); reported ~$5M/yr 2016-2020 (Forbes); also a paid Cypherpunk strategic advisor
entities.summary: Zcash's co-founder is simultaneously a paid advisor to the treasury company holding ~1.9% of supply and Chief Product Officer of the non-profit lab that Cypherpunk's seed investor also funds directly.

entities.title: Winklevoss Capital
entities.role: Venture fund led by Tyler and Cameron Winklevoss; sole institutional investor and lead of Cypherpunk's $58.888M seed placement; investor in ZODL; counterparty selling a mining fleet to Cypherpunk for equity; its principal Will McEvoy sits as Cypherpunk CIO.
entities.summary: The Winklevoss family investment vehicle that seeded, staffs and sells assets into the same public company it created.

entities.title: Gemini
entities.role: Crypto exchange founded by Tyler and Cameron Winklevoss; lists ZEC; first regulated exchange to support shielded ZEC withdrawals; issues a ZEC-denominated rewards credit card.
entities.summary: The Winklevoss exchange whose ZEC products and advocacy predate the 2025-26 rally by five years -- a joint Gemini blog interview with Cameron, Tyler and Zooko dates to 7 Oct 2020.

entities.title: Zcash Open Development Lab (ZODL)
entities.role: For-profit Zcash development company founded by ex-ECC staff after the Jan 2026 walkout; led by Josh Swihart as CEO; employs former ECC core engineers on remediation work; policy office held by Paul Brigner, who also sits on the ZCG grant committee.
entities.exposure: $25M seed round (Mar 2026), including $5M from Cypherpunk
entities.summary: The developer organization Cypherpunk funds directly, whose CEO is simultaneously a paid Cypherpunk advisor.
entities.body: Founded Jan/Feb 2026 by the team that left Electric Coin Company after a governance dispute with the Bootstrap Project board. Raised a $25M seed (announced 9 Mar 2026) with participation from Cypherpunk ($5M SAFE), Winklevoss Capital, a16z, Paradigm, Coinbase Ventures and Balaji Srinivasan. Daira-Emma Hopwood, Jack Grigg and Kris Nuttycombe -- all former ECC core engineers -- are credited as remediation developers on the Orchard soundness bug (CVE-2026-54496) while at ZODL. Josh Swihart is CEO and a paid Cypherpunk strategic advisor at the same time; Paul Brigner is ZODL's Chief Policy & Regulatory Officer while also sitting on the Zcash Community Grants committee.

entities.title: Shielded Labs
entities.role: Non-profit Swiss Association founded Dec 2022 by Jason McGee; employs Zooko Wilcox as Chief Product Officer; funded the halo2 audit that later found the Orchard soundness bug; recipient of Winklevoss and Vitalik Buterin personal donations; co-authored the Jun 2026 Orchard disclosure.
entities.exposure: 3,221 ZEC (~$1.2M) donation from the Winklevoss twins, 21 Jan 2026 (second donation, first in 2023)
entities.summary: Swiss non-profit dev org whose Chief Product Officer simultaneously advises the Nasdaq treasury company that the same donors seeded.

entities.title: Electric Coin Company (ECC)
entities.role: For-profit developer of the original Zcash software, wholly owned subsidiary of the Bootstrap Project since 2020; hollowed out after the Jan 2026 walkout when most engineers left to found ZODL.
entities.exposure: ~112,000 ZEC + ~$806K (Q3 2024) declining to ~83,000 ZEC + ~$1.0M (12 Mar 2025); carries a $3.4M liability to Electric Notes, LLC
entities.summary: Zcash's founding developer company; its former CEO and most engineers are now at ZODL, a company Cypherpunk funds directly.

entities.title: Zcash Foundation (ZF)
entities.role: Delaware 501(c)(3) non-profit (inc. 14 Feb 2017) holding the Zcash trademark; treasury holder; co-controls the NU6 lockbox multisig; Naval Ravikant and Taylor Hornby have both sat on its board.
entities.exposure: 85,412 ZEC ($21.2M of $36.69M liquid assets), Q1 2026
entities.summary: The non-profit steward of the Zcash trademark and a disclosed treasury holder, with board seats held by both an early investor (Naval) and the researcher who found the Orchard bug (Hornby).

entities.title: Grayscale
entities.role: Digital-asset manager owned by DCG; sponsors the Grayscale Zcash Trust and its proposed conversion to a spot ETF (ZCSH); publishes ZEC research.
entities.summary: The DCG-owned asset manager converting its Zcash Trust into an ETF that custodies ZEC transparently at Coinbase.
entities.body: Sponsors the Grayscale Zcash Trust (OTC: ZCSH), filing to convert it into a spot ETF: initial S-3 filed 12 May 2026, Amendment No. 4 on 18 Aug 2026, and a fifth amendment on 22 Aug 2026 naming NYSE Arca, a 2.5% sponsor fee, BNY Mellon as transfer agent and Coinbase Custody as custodian. Grayscale research (Michael Zhao, ~30 Mar 2026) frames ZEC upside on 'a repricing of financial privacy in an AI-driven world' without disclosing that Grayscale itself is the ETF sponsor and Trust holder. The structural contradiction: an ETF built on a privacy coin that holds its ZEC in fully transparent custody.

entities.title: Digital Currency Group (DCG)
entities.role: Holding company founded/led by Barry Silbert; 2015/2016 seed investor in Zerocoin Electric Coin Company; owns Grayscale; in non-binding discussions to contribute ZEC to the Grayscale ETF.
entities.exposure: ~200,000 ZEC (~$110M) contemplated in-kind ETF contribution -- non-binding discussions only, Aug 2026
entities.summary: Barry Silbert's holding company: an original ECC investor, Grayscale's parent, and a prospective direct contributor of ZEC to the ETF it sponsors.

entities.title: Naval Ravikant
entities.role: AngelList founder; 2015 co-investor in Zerocoin Electric Coin Company; founding Zcash Foundation board member; public ZEC advocate.
entities.exposure: $715,000 collective 2015 investment (with Barry Silbert and Roger Ver) into Zerocoin Electric Coin Company; current ZEC holdings undisclosed
entities.summary: An early ECC investor and founding ZF board member who publicly called ZEC 'insurance against Bitcoin' without disclosing the dual role.

entities.title: Barry Silbert
entities.role: DCG founder; Grayscale chairman; 2015/2016 seed co-investor in Zerocoin Electric Coin Company; sold Grayscale Zcash Trust shares during the 2025 rally.
entities.exposure: Filed a Rule 144 notice on 6 Nov 2025 to sell 1,000 Grayscale Zcash Trust shares for $47,250.00. Silbert Family Investments LLC filed separately on 5 Nov 2025 for 9,753 shares, $407,312.59. Both are ZCSH trust shares sold on OTCQX; no ZEC moved on-chain.
entities.summary: Founder of the holding company that owns the ETF sponsor, and an original ECC investor who sold Trust shares into the rally he was publicly promoting as a possible '500x'.

entities.title: Arthur Hayes
entities.role: BitMEX co-founder; Maelstrom CIO; built a large ZEC position through Maelstrom, publicly called a $10,000 ZEC price target, then liquidated the entire position after the Orchard bug disclosure and disclosed the exit.
entities.exposure: Maelstrom ZEC position, size never disclosed; research 03 records it as the family office's second-largest holding after Bitcoin. Exited entirely 4-5 Jun 2026, self-disclosed.
entities.summary: The most prominent ZEC promoter to exit publicly and explain why, which cuts against a simple coordinated-pump reading of the network.
entities.body: The reported $174M ZEC position that Arkham described losing over half its value on 5 June 2026 is NOT this one. Research 04 section 2 records it as an unnamed holder, a party distinct from Hayes, at low confidence, and section 7 records the underlying Arkham post as unlocatable. The corpus contradicts itself here: research 03's holders table attaches the $174M figure to Maelstrom, while research 04, the pass that examined this figure directly, separates them. The quarantine entry U-arkham-174m-position-post holds the unattributed claim; this record states only what Hayes disclosed himself, which is that he liquidated the entire position because exploitation could not be cryptographically proven impossible.

entities.title: Josh Swihart
entities.role: ECC SVP Growth, then ECC CEO (18 Dec 2023 - Jan 2026); led the Jan 2026 walkout; founder/CEO of ZODL; paid strategic advisor to Cypherpunk Technologies; author of ZIP 1016 and the original 2020 'privacy is normal' ECC post.
entities.exposure: Paid Cypherpunk strategic advisor (Dec 2025-); ZODL raised $25M including $5M from Cypherpunk
entities.summary: The developer executive at the center of the loop: he led Zcash's core dev team, then founded the company Cypherpunk funds, while also being paid by Cypherpunk directly.

entities.title: Tyler Winklevoss
entities.role: Gemini co-founder; principal figure of Winklevoss Capital, which seeded Cypherpunk and invests in ZODL; personal donor to Shielded Labs; public ZEC advocate.
entities.exposure: Co-donor of 3,221 ZEC to Shielded Labs (21 Jan 2026); indirect exposure via Winklevoss Capital's Cypherpunk seed and via Gemini
entities.summary: Half of the twin pair whose fund, exchange and personal donations touch every leg of the disclosed Zcash lattice; called ZEC 'encrypted bitcoin' the same day the $58.9M placement was announced.

entities.title: Cameron Winklevoss
entities.role: Gemini co-founder; principal figure of Winklevoss Capital, which seeded Cypherpunk and invests in ZODL; personal donor to Shielded Labs; public ZEC advocate.
entities.exposure: Co-donor of 3,221 ZEC to Shielded Labs (21 Jan 2026); indirect exposure via Winklevoss Capital's Cypherpunk seed and via Gemini
entities.summary: Posted 'Encrypted money with provable correctness is unstoppable' on the day ZEC fell more than 50% on the Orchard bug that had made correctness unprovable for four years.

entities.exposure: 1,000,000 RSUs granted 2 Jul 2026; salary plus equity in a pure-play ZEC vehicle
entities.summary: Sits simultaneously inside the seed investor and the company it seeded, calling ZEC 'the most mispriced asset in crypto' from that position.

entities.title: Multicoin Capital
entities.role: Crypto venture fund; built a 'significant position' in ZEC starting Feb 2026, disclosed by managing partner Tushar Jain.
entities.exposure: Significant position since Feb 2026; size undisclosed
entities.summary: A VC whose single disclosure of an undisclosed-size ZEC position moved the price 30% in a day.

entities.title: Taylor Hornby (defuse, Defuse Security)
entities.role: Independent security researcher; found the 2016 InternalH collision and the 2026 Orchard soundness bug (CVE-2026-54496), ten years apart; runs ZecSec; contracted by Shielded Labs; sits on the Zcash Foundation board.
entities.exposure: Zcash ecosystem security grant recipient (amount undisclosed)
entities.summary: Found the two most severe counterfeiting bugs in Zcash's history while also sitting on the Foundation's board and taking Shielded Labs contract work.

entities.title: Balaji Srinivasan
entities.role: Ex-Coinbase CTO, a16z GP; named investor in ZODL's $25M seed round; public ZEC advocate.
entities.exposure: Named investor in ZODL's $25M seed (Mar 2026)
entities.summary: A named ZODL seed investor who also publicly frames Zcash as one of crypto's true post-Bitcoin innovations.

entities.title: Mert Mumtaz
entities.role: Helius (Solana infrastructure) CEO; frequent public ZEC advocate; never disclosed a ZEC position.
entities.summary: Repeated, colorful public advocacy for ZEC from a Solana-infrastructure CEO with no disclosed position either way.

entities.title: Paul Brigner
entities.role: Chief Policy & Regulatory Officer, ZODL; simultaneously a sitting member of the Zcash Community Grants committee -- a grant-maker employed by the largest grant-eligible dev org.
entities.summary: A structural conflict inside the grant system itself: ZODL's policy chief helps decide which projects the ZCG funds.

entities.title: Zcash Community Grants (ZCG)
entities.role: Community-elected grant committee administered by the Zcash Foundation, funded by 8% of block subsidy; the largest documented body of paid Zcash promotion.
entities.exposure: $20.5M committed (excl. cancelled), $18.7M paid, $1.9M open, 183 approved grants; roughly $3.5-3.8M explicitly promotional
entities.summary: The transparent, milestone-tracked grant program whose funded content rarely re-discloses the funding at the point of consumption.
entities.body: Grant totals from the ZCG ledger: $20.5M committed, $18.7M paid, $1.9M open, across 183 approved grants. Selected marketing/media/community/education lines: Zcash Media 2023 $600,000 (cancelled at 6/9 milestones); ZecHub 2026 $433,079.25 (open); Zcash Brazil 2026 $344,985 (open); Free2Z 'Preparing the Garden For Spring' $333,000 (completed); ZK AV Club Zcash Community Media Infrastructure 2026 $228,545 (open); plus smaller regional, translation and event-sponsorship grants (Zcash Espanol, Nigeria, Turkiye, Ghana, ZcashArabia, readymouse conference marketing $9k-64k, the @_tm3k Twitter Ambassador Program $4,500). Aggregate of explicitly promotional line items is roughly $3.5-3.8M. Governance is genuinely transparent -- applications debated on forum.zcashcommunity.com, milestones tracked, the largest single media grant cancelled for under-delivery -- but Paul Brigner sits on the committee while employed as ZODL's policy chief, and downstream funded content rarely re-discloses the ZCG funding at the point of consumption.

entities.title: Bootstrap Project
entities.role: 501(c)(3) non-profit parent of Electric Coin Company since 2020; its board (Zaki Manian, Christina Garman, Alan Fairless, Michelle Lai) was the counterparty in the Jan 2026 governance dispute that triggered the ECC walkout.
entities.summary: The non-profit parent whose board dispute with ECC's engineers produced the walkout that created ZODL.

entities.title: Douglas E. Onsi
entities.role: President & CEO, Cypherpunk Technologies (carried over from Leap Therapeutics); received a 1,000,000 RSU grant.
entities.exposure: 1,000,000 RSUs granted 2 Jul 2026
entities.summary: Cypherpunk's CEO, framing the treasury strategy as long-term shareholder value while personally holding large RSU upside in the ZEC price.

entities.title: Vitalik Buterin
entities.role: Ethereum co-founder; donor to Shielded Labs' Crosslink (second donation, first in 2023); publicly opposed the token-voting governance change favoured by Naval Ravikant.
entities.summary: A donor rather than a holder, and the ecosystem's clearest public dissent against a fellow promoter (Naval) rather than a promotional voice himself.

entities.title: Tushar Jain
entities.role: Multicoin Capital managing partner; disclosed Multicoin's ZEC position publicly.
entities.exposure: Spokesperson for Multicoin's undisclosed-size ZEC position
entities.summary: The Multicoin partner whose single disclosure moved ZEC's price more than 30% in a day.

entities.title: Grayscale Zcash Trust (ZCSH)
entities.role: OTC trust holding ZEC in Coinbase Custody, sponsored by Grayscale; registering to convert into a spot ETF on NYSE Arca with a 2.5% sponsor fee and BNY Mellon as transfer agent.
entities.exposure: 388,673.68359943 ZEC at 30 Jun 2026 (Q2 10-Q, fair value $155,252k, NAV per share $32.15); 391,103.89 ZEC at 31 Mar 2026; more than $260M in assets claimed 22 Aug 2026.
entities.summary: The institutional ZEC vehicle that, once converted to an ETF, will hold the token in fully transparent custody -- no privacy passes through to shareholders.
entities.body: The ZEC count is the one figure in this graph the corpus states three different ways. Research 04's SEC EDGAR table is itemised by filing date and is the primary record: 392,723.58934327 at 2024-12-31, 392,728.70106678 at 2025-06-30, 393,522.33134026 at 2025-12-31, and 388,673.68359943 at 2026-06-30 against total assets of $155,252k. Research 01 and the dossier's section E.3 both attach the 393,522.33 figure to the Q2 10-Q, but that figure is the 2025-12-31 line in the same table, and the $155,252k it is paired with belongs to the 388,673.68 line. The most recent primary figure is used here and the others are carried alongside it rather than silently dropped.

entities.title: Zcash protocol
entities.role: The Zcash blockchain and its block-subsidy funding mechanism (ZIP 1014 / 1015 / 1016); the asset that every disclosed purchase, listing and donation in this network ultimately references.
entities.summary: Represented here as the common counterparty for on-chain flows -- treasury purchases, exchange listings, the NU6 lockbox -- that do not have a single named recipient.

entities.title: GenZcash
entities.role: Unidentified sponsor of a CoinDesk Research report on Zcash; no grant record, corporate registration or confirmed account was located.
entities.summary: A sponsor that funded major-outlet ZEC research and cannot be identified -- itself one of the dossier's findings.

entities.title: CoinDesk Research
entities.role: Publisher of 'Inside Zcash: Encrypted Money at Planetary Scale' (3 Nov 2025), disclosed as sponsored by GenZcash; supplied the framing later reused as a Messari report title.
entities.summary: The clearest documented case of paid promotional research in mainstream crypto media, three days before ZEC broke $530.

entities.title: Zcash Media
entities.role: ZCG-funded media grantee; its flagship 2023 grant was cancelled at 6 of 9 milestones.
entities.exposure: $600,000 (Zcash Media 2023, cancelled); $213,200 (Launch Plan, completed); $208,014 (Short Documentary, completed)
entities.summary: The largest single ZCG media grant, and the one the program itself cancelled for under-delivery.

entities.title: ZecHub
entities.role: ZCG-funded education and community grantee; produces the ZecHub Visualizer, ZECBounties, wiki content and regional initiatives.
entities.exposure: $433,079.25 (ZecHub 2026, open 9/14); $238,303 (ZecHub 2025, completed); $44,980 + $34,440 (earlier rounds, completed)
entities.summary: The single largest open ZCG education grant, approved by async vote 11 Dec 2025.

entities.title: Zcash Brazil
entities.role: ZCG-funded regional community grantee.
entities.summary: The largest single regional-community line in the ZCG grant ledger.

entities.title: Free2Z
entities.role: ZCG-funded non-wallet-apps grantee.
entities.exposure: $333,000 ('Preparing the Garden For Spring', completed); $123,000 (earlier round, completed); $12,037 (legal expenses reimbursement, completed)
entities.summary: A ZCG-funded applications project, among the larger non-media grant lines in the ledger.

entities.role: ZCG-funded community media-infrastructure grantee.
entities.exposure: $228,545 (Zcash Community Media Infrastructure 2026, open 8/13)
entities.summary: A community media-infrastructure grant within the ZCG's explicitly promotional line items.
